title: Moth-Possums
hook: Player-safe note: Moth-possums cling upside down in warm rafters and unfold soft patterned membranes when soup steam reaches them.

blocks.label: Observed Form
blocks.body: Give one concrete visual, one sound or texture, and one sign of who has used or neglected it.

blocks.label: Behavior
blocks.body: Moth-possums cling upside down in warm rafters and unfold soft patterned membranes when soup steam reaches them.; show instinct first through distance, posture, scent, and how the creature protects what is close to it.

blocks.label: Warning Signs
blocks.body: Being surrounded, misread as a monster, or driven toward The Refuge, Sablewood Hybrid Fauna by noise and haste.

affordances: Give it distance before deciding it is hostile.
Read posture, tracks, and what it is protecting.
